cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Buildings and places inside them; each building is shown from outside or by its typical inside so a child can name it.

words.en: This building is very tall.
words.scene: A large, modern glass building towering over small trees and cars in a city square.
more: The library is an old building.
图书馆是一座古老的建筑。
Look at that red building!
看那座红色的建筑物！

words.en: Our house has a blue roof.
words.sz: 我们的房子有蓝色的屋顶。
more: Grandma's house is near the park.
奶奶的房子在公园附近。
We live in this house.
我们住在这栋房子里。

words.en: Mia lives in a small flat.
words.sz: Mia 住在一个小公寓里。
more: Our flat has two rooms.
我们的公寓有两个房间。
The floor is flat and clean.
地板很平且干净。

words.en: Sam's dad lives in an apartment.
words.sz: Sam 的爸爸住在一套公寓里。
more: The apartment has a nice kitchen.
这套公寓有一个漂亮的厨房。
We visited their apartment yesterday.
我们昨天参观了他们的公寓。

words.en: This apartment building is new.
words.scene: A tall apartment building with many balconies and flowers.
more: My friend lives in that apartment building.
我的朋友住在那栋公寓楼里。
The apartment building has an entrance hall.
这栋公寓楼有一个门厅。

words.en: We live in a block of flats.
words.sz: 我们住在一栋公寓大楼里。
words.scene: A large block of flats in a town.
more: The post office is in the next block.
邮局在下一个街区。
Our school is near this block.
我们学校靠近这个街区。

words.en: Take the lift to the top.
words.scene: The family waiting for the lift in a block of flats, the doors opening.
more: The lift is slow today.
今天电梯很慢。
Let's wait for the lift.
我们等电梯吧。

words.en: Lily waits for the elevator.
words.scene: Lily pressing the button inside an elevator in a hotel (no numbers).
more: The elevator goes up quickly.
电梯上升得很快。
We took the elevator to the top floor.
我们坐电梯到了顶楼。

words.en: The entrance is open.
more: We met at the school entrance.
我们在学校入口处见面。
Please use this entrance.
请使用这个入口。

words.en: The exit is on the left.
words.scene: People leaving a cinema through the exit door, a green light above it (no writing).
more: Look for the fire exit.
寻找消防出口。
We left through the back exit.
我们从后出口离开了。

words.en: Dad parks in the garage.
more: The bikes are in the garage.
自行车在车库里。
Max sleeps near the garage.
Max 睡在车库附近。

words.en: We stayed at a big hotel.
words.sz: 我们住在一家大酒店里。
words.scene: A big hotel with a doorman and taxis outside.
more: The hotel has a swimming pool.
这家酒店有一个游泳池。
Our room in the hotel is nice.
我们在酒店的房间很好。

words.en: We slept in a guest-house.
words.sz: 我们睡在一家家庭旅馆里。
words.scene: A small pretty house by the sea with flowers, a family arriving with bags.
more: The guest-house is quiet at night.
这家小旅馆晚上很安静。
Grandma likes this guest-house.
奶奶喜欢这家家庭旅馆。

words.en: The castle is very old.
words.scene: A grand stone castle with high towers and a drawbridge, surrounded by green grass.
more: Lily likes the big castle.
Lily 喜欢那座大城堡。
We visited the castle yesterday.
我们昨天参观了城堡。

words.en: Lily goes to school by bus.
more: Tom's school is next door.
Tom 的学校就在隔壁。
We play football at school.
我们在学校踢足球。

words.en: My cousin goes to college.
more: The college is big and green.
这所学院很大且绿意盎然。
Kate teaches at a college.
Kate 在一所学院教书。

words.en: Dad went to university.
more: The university is in London.
这所大学在伦敦。
Sam wants to study at university.
Sam 想在大学学习。

words.en: We read books in the library.
more: The library is quiet and cool.
图书馆安静且凉爽。
Lily returns her book to the library.
Lily 把书还给图书馆。

words.en: Dad works in an office.
words.scene: Dad sitting at a desk in a bright office, a computer and a lamp on the desk, a plant in the corner and a big window behind him.
more: The office has many desks.
办公室里有许多桌子。
Mum visits Dad's office.
妈妈参观爸爸的办公室。

words.en: The factory makes toys.
words.scene: a big factory with machines making toy cars.
more: Sam's uncle works in a factory.
Sam 的叔叔在一家工厂工作。
The factory is very noisy.
这家工厂很吵。

words.en: Kate works in a bank.
words.scene: a big stone bank building with columns, people going in
more: Mum goes to the bank on Friday.
妈妈星期五去银行。
The bank is next to the post office.
银行在邮局旁边。

words.en: Lily sends a letter at the post office.
words.scene: Lily posting a parcel at the post office counter
more: The post office is on Park Road.
邮局在公园路。
Grandma buys stamps at the post office.
奶奶在邮局买邮票。

words.en: Sam lives near the police station.
words.scene: a police station building with a police car outside (no writing)
more: The police station is open all day.
警察局全天开放。
Tom sees a police officer at the police station.
Tom 在警察局看到一位警察。

words.en: Mum works at the hospital.
words.scene: A big white hospital building with an ambulance parked at the door, Lily and Tom walking up the steps with Mum, Tom holding a big bunch of flowers, the sun coming out.
more: The hospital is very big.
医院很大。
Grandpa visits the doctor at the hospital.
爷爷去医院看医生。

words.en: Mum buys medicine at the pharmacy.
words.scene: a pharmacist giving Mum a box of medicine across the counter
more: The pharmacy is closed on Sunday.
药房星期日不营业。
Ask for help at the pharmacy.
在药房寻求帮助。

words.en: We drink tea in the cafe.
more: The cafe has nice cakes.
这家咖啡馆有美味的蛋糕。
Let's meet at the cafe after school.
放学后我们在咖啡馆见。

words.en: Lily eats lunch in the cafeteria.
more: The school cafeteria is busy at noon.
学校食堂中午很热闹。
We sit together in the cafeteria.
我们在食堂坐在一起。

words.en: We watch a film at the cinema.
words.scene: Lily and Tom with popcorn in a dark cinema watching the big screen
more: The cinema is next to the park.
电影院在公园旁边。
Tom loves going to the cinema.
Tom 喜欢去电影院。

words.en: The family goes to the theatre.
words.scene: a theatre stage with red curtains, the family in their seats
more: We see a play at the theatre.
我们在剧院看戏。
The theatre is very old and beautiful.
这座剧院很古老也很漂亮。

words.en: We learn about history at the museum.
words.sz: 我们在博物馆学习历史。
words.scene: Lily and Tom looking up at a big dinosaur model in a museum hall, a kind guide smiling beside them, tall windows and stone steps behind.
more: The museum is open on Saturday.
博物馆星期六开放。
Lily draws pictures of old things at the museum.
Lily 在博物馆画老物件的图。

words.en: The school has a disco tonight.
words.sz: 学校今晚有迪斯科舞会。
words.scene: children dancing at a school disco with coloured lights
more: Lily dances at the disco.
Lily 在迪斯科舞会上跳舞。
Tom listens to music at the disco.
Tom 在迪斯科舞会上听音乐。

words.en: We play tennis at the sports centre.
words.sz: 我们在体育中心打网球。
more: The sports centre is near my home.
体育中心在我家附近。
Dad runs in the sports centre.
爸爸在体育中心跑步。

words.en: Lily watches football at the stadium.
more: The stadium is full of fans.
体育场里挤满了球迷。
We take a bus to the stadium.
我们坐公共汽车去体育场。

words.en: Tom swims in the swimming pool.
more: The water in the swimming pool is blue.
游泳池里的水是蓝色的。
We go to the swimming pool on Sunday.
我们星期日去游泳池。

words.en: Mum goes to the shop.
words.scene: A small corner shop with fruit and vegetables in baskets outside, Mum choosing apples.
more: The shop sells milk and bread.
这家商店卖牛奶和面包。
Let's shop for a new ball.
我们去买一个新球吧。

words.en: We buy food at the supermarket.
words.scene: A bright supermarket aisle with tall shelves of tins and packets, Dad pushing a trolley, Lily holding a box of cereal.
more: The supermarket is very big.
这家超市很大。
Grandma pays at the supermarket.
奶奶在超市付款。

words.en: Lily buys a book at the bookshop.
words.sz: Lily 在书店买了一本书。
words.scene: Lily choosing a book in a cosy bookshop with full shelves
more: The bookshop is quiet and warm.
书店安静又温暖。
We visit the bookshop on Saturday.
我们星期六去书店。

words.en: Sam reads in the bookstore.
words.scene: a big modern bookstore with a café corner
more: The bookstore has many floors.
这家书店有很多层。
We meet friends at the bookstore.
我们在书店见朋友。

words.en: Mum shops at the department store.
words.scene: a big department store with many floors and moving stairs inside
more: The department store sells clothes.
这家百货商店卖衣服。
We take the lift in the department store.
我们在百货商店坐电梯。

words.en: Dad buys eggs at the grocery store.
words.scene: a small shop full of food, tins and vegetables
more: The grocery store has fresh fruit.
这家杂货店有新鲜水果。
We walk to the grocery store.
我们步行去杂货店。
